name: Create a Claude Code project
description: Registers a directory as a Claude Code project at runtime. Venue authority is required (claudecode/manage on <venueDID>/claudecode/projects — call as the venue or present a venue-issued delegation): naming a directory the venue's own OS user may execute code in is an operator decision. 'user' names who owns the project (that user and their agents may run in it; others need a delegation from them) — a DID, 'public' (the venue's public principal) or 'venue'; it defaults to the caller. The project is recorded at w/claudecode/projects/<name> in the venue workspace and re-armed at every start. Config-declared projects cannot be created or replaced this way.

path.description: Absolute path of an existing directory — Claude Code's working directory

user.description: Owner: a DID, 'public' or 'venue' (default: the caller)

options.description: Project-level Claude Code options (model, permissionMode, allowedTools, disallowedTools, tools, maxTurns, maxBudgetUsd, appendSystemPrompt, systemPrompt, effort, addDirs, mcpConfig, strictMcpConfig, settings, keepAlive, env) overlaying the adapter defaults; env values may be s/NAME secret references
